items.title: A 10-year-old CNN outperforms frontier LLMs for skin cancer diagnosis (5 minute read)
items.snippet: A small, old, and specialized network with an outdated architecture recognizes skin lesions far better than GPT-6 Astra and Claude Fable 5.1.

items.title: Cursor can now control your computer (2 minute read)

items.title: Gemini 4 Carbon early test results are in ahead of release (3 minute read)
items.snippet: Google's Gemini 4 Carbon early access testing shows it improves 3D capabilities over Argon but remains weak in UI performance and is slower.

items.title: Anthropic S-1 Analysis: How 7 Key Metrics Stack Up
items.snippet: Analyze Anthropic's S-1 IPO metrics : $4.6B revenue growing 11.9-fold, a derived 40% gross margin, $974M of operating profit in Q2, & $637B of compute commitments.
